text: dsh-plugin-gemini-theme 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的 Gemini 风格主题插件。它通过 bundle 将客户端插件条目加入 Web 配置，并在浏览器插件生命周期内挂载一张 style 表，覆盖客户端的 --dsw-* 设计令牌和 CSS Modules 类。它调整明暗配色、侧栏胶囊行、新建会话按钮、首屏标题、输入框圆角与阴影、滚动渐隐和进场动画，并在运行中显示顶部扫光。适合希望把 DSH 网页界面改成 Gemini 视觉风格的用户；无需 API key 或外部账号，安装后需重启 dsh web。

dsh-plugin-gemini-theme restyles the DSH web client with Gemini-like light and dark colors, rounded sidebar rows and composer, hero animations, scroll fades, and a running-turn sweep. It mounts a stylesheet in the browser; no API key is needed.
想把 DSH 网页版的外观换成 Gemini 那种简洁配色和圆角布局。
有没有能同时调整 DSH 浅色和深色主题的皮肤？
让 DSH 的侧边栏和新建会话按钮看起来更像 Gemini。
我想给聊天输入框加上更柔和的圆角、阴影和蓝色光晕。
能不能让 DSH 空白会话打开时有轻巧的入场动画？
希望网页端的会话列表行变成胶囊形，并改善滚动区域的渐隐效果。
I want the DSH web interface to use a Gemini-like visual style.
Can I restyle the sidebar, composer, and light and dark palettes in DSH?
dsh-plugin-gemini-theme 的功能「明暗主题配色」：为客户端浅色和深色模式覆盖背景、文字、边框、品牌色及阴影令牌。客户端切换主题时由对应的 body 属性选择配色。
dsh-plugin-gemini-theme 的功能「侧栏与会话列表样式」：调整侧栏填充、新建会话按钮、会话与项目行的胶囊圆角，并为列表元素添加轻量进场效果。打开 Web 客户端即可生效。
dsh-plugin-gemini-theme 的功能「输入框外观」：为首屏和活动会话中的输入区设置填充、圆角、边框和阴影，并在首屏输入区后呈现蓝色光晕。聚焦输入框时沿用主题填充。
dsh-plugin-gemini-theme 的功能「界面动效」：空白会话的标题、侧栏和输入卡片采用渐入动效；生成回复时页面顶部显示蓝色扫光，并遵循减少动态效果偏好关闭相关动画。

dsh-plugin-gemini-theme README · dsh-plugin-gemini-theme：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A Gemini-styled skin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web client.

One stylesheet, layered over the client's own `--dsw-*` design tokens. The plugin contributes no DOM, no slot occupant and no service — installing it changes how the client looks, removing it restores the stock appearance, and nothing else in the stack knows the difference.

dsh-plugin-gemini-theme README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-gemini-theme
```

Restart `dsh web` afterwards. Remove it the same way:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-gemini-theme
```

dsh-plugin-gemini-theme README · What it restyles：The conversation ground and sidebar fill, the sidebar's capsule rows and round icon buttons, the new-chat pill, the hero greeting's scale, the composer's radius, fill and elevation, the blue backdrop glow behind it, the entrance animation when a blank session opens, and the fades at both ends of the scrolling regions.

Light and dark are both covered; the sheet follows whichever the client resolves.

dsh-plugin-gemini-theme README · How it works：The sheet mounts as a `<style>` tag under the plugin's own lifetime. Rules reach their targets through the class form CSS modules compile to — `[hash]_[local]`, so a rule is written `[class*="_local"]` — which is what lets a skin live outside the packages it restyles. It loads before every feature package's own stylesheet, so its component rules carry `!important`.

dsh-plugin-gemini-theme README · How it works：That substring match is also the main hazard: `_local` matches any module that happens to name a class the same way. Rules that could reach a second component are narrowed by a tag qualifier, a `:has()` on something only the intended target contains, or an ancestor only the intended tree has.

Colours and sizes were sampled per-pixel from a reference rather than estimated; the comments in the sheet record where each number came from.

dsh-plugin-gemini-theme README · Limitations：Anything needing new DOM is out of scope for a stylesheet and is not here:

- The session header keeps its stock strip (title, mode chip, view tabs) rather than filing them behind one control.
- The hero greeting is the client's own line, not a rotating one.
- The sidebar opens in whatever state the client decides; the skin does not change its boot posture or width.
- No top progress bar during a turn — that needs a DOM signal the client does not publish.
